items.title: Imperial Petroleum Inc. Announces Pricing of $60.0 Million Registered Direct Offering
items.summary: Athens, Greece, November 28, 2025 – Imperial Petroleum Inc. (NASDAQ:IMPP) ("Imperial Petroleum" or the "Company"), a ship-owning company providing petroleum products, crude oil, and drybulk seaborne transportation services, today announced that it has entered into a securities purchase agreement with two institutional investors for the sale of 9,523,900 shares of the Company’s common stock (or prefunded warrants in lieu thereof) and accompanying Class F warrants to purchase up to 9,523,900 shares of common stock and Class G warrants to purchase up to 9,523,900 shares of common stock at a combined purchase price of $6.30 per share and accompanying warrants (the “Offering”). The Class F and Class G warrants will have an exercise price equal to $6.30, will be immediately exercisable, and will expire five years following the date of issuance. Gross proceeds for the Offering are expected to be approximately $60.0 million, before deducting commissions and offering expenses. Maxim Group LLC is acting as the sole placement agent for the Offering.
